[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Genlan Sossu''' was a [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Sossu wrote the journal ''[[Blood Fortune: The Rise of the Sith Empire's Industrialist Families]]'' which consisted of at least three volumes. The third volume included information about the [[Dosk family]] and the early life of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Cadmael Benthos Dosk]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Major Cadmael Benthos Dosk}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dr. Genlan Sossu was first mentioned in the codex entry for Cadmael Benthos Dosk introduced in Game Update 7.0: ''Legacy of the Sith'', released on [[February 15]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="LotS">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220215-0|text=The 'Legacy of the Sith' expansion is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
